name: CORE (Common Open Research Emulator)
description: Common Open Research Emulator - tool for emulating networks on one or more machines with ability to connect emulated networks to live networks. Provides GUI and Python scripting modules.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Repository contains a /dockerfiles directory for containerized deployment.

eval_notes: Established network emulator with GUI and Python API. Good for network topology design and routing protocol evals in containerized environments. Research-grade network emulator from US Naval Research Laboratory. Lightweight virtual machines with real-time emulation. Python scripting API enables automated topology creation and testing. Good for MANET/wireless network digital twins. GUI-based network emulator with wireless/RF emulation via EMANE. Good for mobile/wireless network evaluations. Python scripting API enables automation for agentic use.
